title: My Gaming Studios has an interactive dashboard
author: Rob-Gardner
selftext:
Built this yesterday because I was constantly struggling with the organizational side of this. 

Runs from my website, and hooks into Grokbot, GPT / Dots, and Claude Code. 

There were a couple huge unlocks for me.  First I run all my projects under one Claude project.  I used to have them in multiple but they couldn't interact.  By having the entire thing in one project i can set up each thread as its own agent.  Then set up permanent threads, for my website manager,  editors,  CTO,  etc..  This has made it infinitely easier to organize / structure and maintain.

The second is a bit of a hack but using Github PRs, allows me to have real time interaction between the other 2 clients.  Grokbot is my content team that handles copies,  buffer,  social media.   and GPT can edit my claude settings, since claude cant, but also does several other specializations.  

I tied the system into elevenlabs,  so whenever one of my agents needs something it actually talks to me and waves to me and tells me who they are and what the problem is.   No phone calls needed.   

Now I just get to focus on the creative side and I have never had more technical control...
